notes: Rebuilt, more reliable Nova Proxy. The panel now ships inside the Worker, so there is no separate origin to configure. Adds Workers + Pages dual front doors for automatic failover, AmneziaWG subscriptions, an ad and adult-content block toggle, sing-box 1.12+ support, an installable app (Add to Home Screen), panel backup and restore, and an in-panel update check. Your users, settings, and data are preserved on update.
